description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the AppManager plugin for the WPEFramework. It contains class definitions, method implementations, and plugin registration code related to managing application lifecycle and notifications within the framework.

classes.name: AppManager
classes.description: Main class implementing the application management plugin, handling initialization, deinitialization, notifications, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: AppManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the singleton instance and setting up initial state.

methods.name: ~AppManager
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and resetting singleton instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, sets up connections, and registers for notifications.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases connections.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin-specific information; currently returns an empty string.
